summary: An 8-by-8-foot frame cab built in 1933 north of Libby, abandoned in 1942 and listed as gone; the sources say little more about the site.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1942 and listed as gone. No source describes what remains at the site today.

evidence.supports: about three miles north of Libby

evidence.quote: The lookout on Sheldon mountain, is 4500 feet above the level of the sea and 4 1/2 miles from Libby.

sources.title: Sheldon Mountain, Forest Lookouts, western US

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only firelookout.com gives the 1933 cab and 1942 abandonment; the 1930 Western News item is the only other dated mention. Three web searches and a check of two Western News lookout articles found nothing more on Sheldon. Conflicts left open: distance from Libby is three miles north per firelookout.com but four and a half miles per the 1930 item; elevation 4,476 ft vs 4,500 ft (rounded). Brief location conflict is unresolved: FFLA point 48.445, -115.52452 vs a map point on the Kemnow page at about 48.4544, -115.5199 (about 1.1 km apart, as the brief notes). No location correction proposed because neither source can be checked against the site. Access and today's condition are unknown.
